caption:
Saturday's Sky is Yang Water, The Ocean 🌊 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's big ocean meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Water gets a friend day, Yang Metal gets a joy day, Yang Fire feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

What are your Saturday plans? Comment your element below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #weekendvibes #astrology #fiveelements #chineseastrology #knowyourself #fourpillars #dailyhoroscope #sgig
day_line: An ocean on a Dragon day. Big and lively: good for outings and fresh ideas, easy to overbook the weekend.

lines.Yang Wood: A Saturday walk sparks something. Leave the earphones out for once.
lines.Yin Wood: Someone takes care of you today. Let them pick the brunch spot.
lines.Yang Fire: The weekend list runs long today. Cut it in half; keep the fun bits.
lines.Yin Fire: Someone appreciates you out loud today. Don't wave it away; say thanks.
lines.Yang Earth: A good deal turns up today. Check you really need it, then pounce.
lines.Yin Earth: Meal-prep Saturday pays off. Cook once, eat well till Tuesday.
lines.Yang Metal: Play mode is on today. Try the new café, not the usual one.
lines.Yin Metal: Your eye for detail helps today. Tell a friend which outfit wins.
lines.Yang Water: Your crew is up for anything today. Say yes to the beach or the hike.
lines.Yin Water: Someone books your favourite spot today. Find a new one; it might be better.
